title: ClosureEffectBoundaryContract
description: Schema for CLOSURE Effect-Bound Approval requests, boundary definitions, and runtime enforcement states.

session_id.description: Unique UUID for the agent command interception session

agent_id.description: Identifier of the requesting AI agent

working_directory.description: Execution working directory path inside sandbox

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the interception session

allowed_read_paths.description: Glob patterns or absolute paths permitted for file reading

allowed_write_paths.description: Glob patterns or absolute paths permitted for file write/create/delete

allowed_network_hosts.description: Permitted outbound IP addresses, subnets, or domain names (e.g. registry.npmjs.org)

allowed_executables.description: List of permitted binary names or paths allowed in execve

deny_sensitive_paths.description: Explicit blacklisted paths that trigger instant hard block (e.g. /etc/shadow, ~/.ssh, /etc/passwd)
